assign_despot = {
	message = yes
	on_own_nation = yes

	potential = {
		always = no # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
		scope:actor = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix"
		}
	}

	ai_tick = never
	ai_tick_frequency = 6

	price = price:assign_despot_price

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_ruler = yes
			ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_character"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_female = no
			NOT = { has_character_modifier = despot_modifier }
			has_dynasty = yes
			is_ruler = no
		}
		enabled = {
			is_adult = yes
			dynasty ?= scope:actor.ruler.dynasty
		}
	}

	effect = {
        scope:recipient = {
            add_character_modifier = {
                mode = add_and_extend
                modifier = despot_modifier
                years = -1
            }
        }
	}

   ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = scope:recipient.total_abilities
			subtract = 250
		}

		add = {
			value = scope:actor.estate_satisfaction:nobles_estate
			# remap to -1 to 0
			subtract = 1

			# intensity
			multiply = 50
		}

		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							is_general = yes
							is_admiral = yes
						}
					}
				}
				value = 30
			}
		}

		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							has_trait_category = general
							has_trait_category = admiral
						}
					}
				}
				value = 30
			}
		}
    }
}
